paper.title: OpenWAM: An Open, Modular Exploration Towards Systematic World-Action Model Pretraining
paper.data: 518.5M frames (about 6,400 hours) of egocentric human and robot data represented in an 80-D unified action space.
paper.method: Modular WAM infrastructure and controlled design studies instantiate a model with dedicated action capacity, world-to-action information flow, and synchronized joint denoising.
paper.task: Pretrain and evaluate generalist world-action models across eight simulation benchmarks and three real-robot platforms.
paper.novelty: Turns tightly coupled WAM design into a controlled modular program and releases the resulting full stack.
paper.project_relevance: Direct implementation reference for modular world/action coupling, unified action spaces, simulator evaluation, and reproducible ablations.

paper.title: Show-Harness: Just a VLM Agent Can Play Robots
paper.data: GUMI demonstrations, released corpus and six LoRA adapters, with simulation and real-robot evaluation.
paper.method: Semantic actions grounded by embodiment-specific interpreters inside a perceive-reason-act plugin loop.
paper.task: Enable frontier and small open VLMs to control heterogeneous robots and collect demonstrations through one interface.
paper.novelty: Makes the model-facing action interface a reusable cross-embodiment abstraction.
paper.project_relevance: Reusable embodied action schema, interpreter boundary, safety projection, and low-cost demonstration collection pattern.

paper.title: ActSafeGuard: Differentiable and Training-Aligned Constraint Enforcement for Flow-Matching Policies
paper.data: Experiments on pi0.5 and Fast-WAM across constrained manipulation tasks.
paper.method: Analytical ray-shooting rescales each discrete flow update to the feasible boundary while preserving differentiability.
paper.task: Train and deploy flow-matching VLA/WAM policies with hard per-step feasibility.
paper.novelty: Integrates deterministic constraint enforcement into both training and inference.
paper.project_relevance: Executable action-validity layer and training-aligned safety primitive for flow-based policies.

paper.title: Gamma-World: Generative Multi-Agent World Modeling Beyond Two Players
paper.data: Synchronized multi-agent gameplay and real multi-robot sequences with released workflows.
paper.method: Simplex agent encoding, sparse hub attention, and causal distillation with KV caching.
paper.task: Generate one coherent action-responsive video world for multiple independent agents.
paper.novelty: Extends interactive world models beyond one controller with permutation-equivalent identities and scalable communication.
paper.project_relevance: Direct reference for synchronized multi-agent generation and shared-world consistency.
